title: Print a name badge
prompt: Print two lines, exactly: `Name: Ada Lovelace`, then `Role: engineer`.
hints: Put each line's text in double quotes inside Console.WriteLine( ).
Check the capital letters: Name, Ada, Lovelace and Role start with a capital. engineer does not.
checkLabels: The output must be Name: Ada Lovelace, then Role: engineer, on two lines.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Prints the role before the name.
Changes a capital letter in the required text.

feedback: Compare each printed line with the prompt. The order of the lines and every capital letter must match.
